Where to catch Pidgeot

FRLG snapshot below. Overview follows the edition dock.

Pidgeot cannot be caught in the wild in FireRed/LeafGreen. You only get it through evolution: Pidgeotto evolves into Pidgeot starting at level 36.

Electric (×2), Ice (×2), Rock (×2). Resists Grass, Bug, immune to Ground, Ghost. Calculated from the gen 3 type chart (FireRed/LeafGreen).

Pidgey evolves into Pidgeotto starting at level 18. Pidgeotto evolves into Pidgeot starting at level 36.

Not in the wild. Pidgeot cannot be caught in the wild in FireRed/LeafGreen. You only get it through evolution: Pidgeotto evolves into Pidgeot starting at level 36.

Our take: Early on, yes. Pidgeot reliably carries the early game but gets outscaled by its movepool later. A classic route 1 bird: useful, but replaceable.
